service.ur: درآمد کنندہ یا برآمد کنندہ کوڈ

about: Customs code a company needs to import or export goods through Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Customs fees guide page on the checked date. Services are requested through TAMM, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 100 for a company importer or exporter code
AED 25 for renewing an importer code
channels: TAMM platform (tamm.abudhabi), as linked from the Abu Dhabi Customs site
